name: B10-0448/2026 (Renew) – Attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Georgia's ruling party, Georgian Dream, which is trying to ban five major opposition parties through the courts. The Parliament condemns this, along with the imprisonment of opposition figures, activists and journalists, and laws that limit civil society. It asks Georgia to repeal these laws and release those held, and asks European Union countries to pressure Georgia's leaders, including with visa bans.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, courts, opposition parties, activists and journalists.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to European Union institutions and Georgia's authorities; European Union countries are asked to consider sanctions and visa bans.
